before=current_frame
res=action(['SPACE'])
after=current_frame
print('result',{k:res.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','done','level_completed','game_over','reward')})
def bb(f,col,minp=20):
    out=[]
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']==col and n['pixels']>=minp:
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            out.append((min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs),n['pixels']))
    return out
for col in 'BcY':
    print(col,'before',bb(before,col),'after',bb(after,col))
# check shape of black after: top bar row & bottom bar row extents
a=after.ascii.split('\n')
for rr in (18,19,28,29):
    B=[c for c in range(64) if a[rr][c]=='B']
    print('row',rr,'B',(min(B),max(B),len(B)) if B else None)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
